name: openreality-mcp
description: Phone video to an AI-queryable 3D scene: reconstruct, measure, plan paths, export robot-training data.
long_description:
Scan a room with your phone, then ask Claude about it. Open Reality turns plain video into a persistent 3D scene that Claude can measure (distances, angles, floor and wall planes), navigate (path planning through the scanned free space), inspect (objects, keyframes, rendered views), and export as robot-training data (LeRobot / GR00T style datasets, Isaac Sim scenes).

Honesty is built in: a length is only reported in metres after you calibrate the scene with one real-world distance; until then every number is labelled as relative units, and the Isaac export is refused. Server refusals and uncertainty labels reach Claude unedited.

The extension runs on your machine and talks to an Open Reality server over HTTPS: the hosted service at open-reality.io, or your own self-hosted server (set the Server URL below). Sign in once with `npx -y openreality-mcp login`, or paste an API token.

tools.name: workspace_upload_video
tools.description: Upload a phone video and start a 3D reconstruction job.

tools.name: workspace_list_scenes
tools.description: List the scenes in the account and which ones are new since last sync.

tools.name: scene_card
tools.description: A short honest summary of one scene: source, metric state, objects, artifacts.

tools.name: scene_measure_distance
tools.description: Distance between two points; metres only after the scene is anchored.

tools.name: scene_anchor
tools.description: Calibrate the scene to metres from two points and one known real distance.

tools.name: scene_planes
tools.description: Floor and wall planes of the scene.

tools.name: scene_plan_path
tools.description: Plan a path through the scanned free space to a point or an object.

tools.name: scene_list_objects
tools.description: The detected objects in the scene (a closed world).

tools.name: export_prepare
tools.description: Build a robot-training export (openreality, groot_lerobot_v2, or isaac_usd).

tools.name: artifact_fetch
tools.description: Download any scene artifact or export to disk; bytes never enter the chat.

tools.name: agent_chat
tools.description: Ask the server-side scene agent a question about the scene.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Leave empty for the hosted service (open-reality.io). Set it to your own server's URL if you self-host.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Optional. Paste an ork_ API key, or leave empty and run `npx -y openreality-mcp login` once in a terminal.
